# Widefleet SSO

The OAuth2 Proxy and configuration supervisor for Widefleet, an open-source, self-hosted platform for internal apps and workflows. It provides company sign-in for published apps.

Follow the [self-hosting guide](https://widefleet.com/docs/self-hosting/installation) to configure identity and run it with the other Widefleet services.

[Website](https://widefleet.com) · [Documentation](https://widefleet.com/docs) · [Source code](https://github.com/widefleet/widefleet)
